row.note_raw_vs_clipped: raw>0 只说明未截断前为正；判定用截断后的实际 λ_B（n_lambda_effective_positive）
row.reason: 价格→评分→排序/动作 三级均可观察 ⇒ 机制可识别；效果方向与显著性归 P1-A 效果门，本函数不判

reading: n_lambda_effective_positive is the number of decisions where the ENDOGENOUSLY chosen lambda differs from the grid floor; the grid floor is 0.25 (never 0), so the price term is active in all 1000 decisions and 709 decisions carry a price above the floor. raw>0 and the clipped effective price are therefore distinguished: here raw>0 == 1000 but the informative quantity is the 709 above-floor decisions.
